positive_terms: All employees in own workforce are covered by social protection, through public programs or through benefits offered, against loss of income due to unemployment starting from when own worker is working for undertaking
员工因失业失去收入的社保覆盖
说明所有员工自为雇主工作起，是否通过公共计划或主体福利获得失业收入损失的社保覆盖。须说明适用主体、期间与报告边界；泛泛表述不能替代。
